column1: REGISTRATION  OF  TITLE ACT, No.  21 OF  1998
Declaration  of  Determination  of  the  Commissioner  of  Title  Settlement  under  Section  14
BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-
clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the  title to parcel of Land Nos. 42 and 49 of Block 01,
contained in the Cadastral Map No. 310009, situated in the Village of Enamaluwa within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. E/451 -
Enamaluwa in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Dambulla, in the District of Matale, in the Province of Central, referred to in No-
tice No. 31/0001 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 1678/28 of 03rd November, 2010 in
terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998.
